summary_en: This study tests JAB-30355, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a TP53 Y220C mutation. It is taken orally; how long or how often it is taken is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body, and early signs of antitumor activity; it is a Phase 1/2a study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba JAB-30355, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación TP53 Y220C. Se toma por vía oral; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se toma. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se mueve el medicamento por el cuerpo y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral; es un estudio de Fase 1/2a.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced solid tumors.
Received at least one line of systemic therapy for their tumor type and stage.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1, and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate blood, kidney, liver and clotting function, and able to swallow and retain oral medicine.
not_for: Active brain or spinal metastases, or a primary brain or spinal cord tumor.
Active infection needing systemic treatment within 7 days.
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
Any severe or uncontrolled medical condition.
LVEF 50% or lower, or QTcF above 470 msec.
